name: Alto Metals Limited
summary: Alto Metals Limited primarily explores for gold properties. Its flagship project is the Sandstone gold project covering an area of approximately 800 square kilometers located in the East Murchison Mineral field in Western Australia. The company was formerly known as Enterprise Uranium Limited and changed its name to Alto Metals Limited in May 2016. Alto Metals Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
